slots.title: Next Generation at Medeo #5
slots.summary: Your pitch (Nov. 5): Medeo Youth Challenge #5 (Bound Brook, Sun. Nov. 8) drew eight Elite FC fencers, five of them in Y10 Mixed (Ian Huang, Nora Li, Elle Peterfreund, Claire Widjaja, Roy Yoo), plus Samuel SarroWaite (Y12 Men), Owen Li (Y14 Men) and Mira Shukla (Y14 Women).
